about_the_game:
100 mischievous cats are hiding and it’s your mission to find them all. Search every corner, solve light puzzles, and bring each scene to life by coloring it in a calm and relaxing environment.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE

  • A beautifully hand-drawn map full of detail and charm.

  • Relax by coloring with guided numbers or a free color palette.

  • 100 hidden cats to discover.

  • Invite a friend to join your search through online co-op.

  • Light lo-fi music and ambient sounds to enhance your creativity.

  • Share your art in the community gallery, vote for others, and join monthly contests.

  • Easy-to-use controls, adjustable zoom, and color-blind-friendly palettes make it accessible to everyone.
